dataset.name: CoLeaf-DB
dataset.reference: Tuesta-Monteza, Mejia-Cabrera, Arcila-Diaz. CoLeaf-DB: Peruvian coffee leaf images dataset for coffee leaf nutritional deficiencies detection and classification. Data in Brief, 2023.

what_this_file_is: Per-image MD5 of the working copy used for every reported result, so a reader can confirm they hold the same data. Produced by analysis/dataset_audit.py; see provenance/README.md.

split.note: The nine seen-class directories supply 902 images; more-deficiencies supplies the 104 compound target images.

exact_duplicates.note: No compound target image duplicates a seen-class image, so the zero-shot evaluation is not contaminated by a training image.

perceptual_screen.note: A perceptual (dHash) screen is implemented in analysis/dataset_audit.py with a user-settable Hamming threshold. Near-duplicate is not a property of the data but a choice of threshold, so no single threshold's pair list is published here; run the script with --phash-distance to reproduce it at whatever threshold you prefer.
